assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished transparent pixel art prop atlas for the existing Chinese-influenced fantasy adventure RPG. A single portrait canvas with aspect ratio 3:4, divided into exactly THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS of equal square cells (target 1536 by 2048). Exactly twelve independent props in the following order, one wholly inside each cell. Absolutely transparent RGBA background, no backdrop, labels, text, frames or grid. Leave 12% transparent margin on all sides of every cell. Center each prop horizontally with feet near 85% of its cell height; never cross cell boundaries. Row 1: LEFT a weathered wood roadside lantern post with a bronze cap, small warm amber light, slate rocky footing; CENTER a small ivory folded travel letter with a dark red wax seal, wrapped string and a few curled pages resting on a wooden box, no writing; RIGHT three delicate pale turquoise tidebud flowers among elegant green leaves and a moist rock base. Row 2: LEFT a clump of pale lavender alpine snowflowers, frosted blue-green leaves and a little snow on a grounded rock; CENTER a short old dark-blue carved stone rune marker with bronze bindings and a restrained pale cyan crossed rune, small mossy footing; RIGHT a charming dark teal wooden roadside mailbox with a narrow mail slot, bronze trim, three small colored tokens below the slot and a short supporting wooden stake. Row 3: LEFT an open parchment road ledger on a compact rough wooden table with a warm hanging lantern on one side, weathered grain and little stones at the foot; CENTER a small wood-framed maritime notice board showing simple blue tide-line diagrams (no actual letters), rope loop and wooden feet; RIGHT a winter watch workbench with folded slate-blue duty cloak, wooden name tokens, a small metal cup of hot soup and a pale fur cap, a little snow on the corners. Row 4: LEFT a sturdy wooden combat practice dummy with a round straw archery target head, leather bindings, a wooden crosspiece and compact weighted stone base; CENTER a compact fishing station prop with a thin curved wooden fishing rod, dangling line and red float, small wooden bucket and neat tackle box on a little rocky footing; RIGHT a horizontal ancient carved stone sluice barrier module with iron clamps, weathered faceted blue-grey stone courses, a narrow bronze top trim and old embossed geometric rune medallion, low wall aspect 3:1, entirely within its cell, suitable to repeat horizontally. Style: cohesive authentic hand-placed-looking pixel fantasy RPG art with a clear logical 64-96 pixel resolution per prop; crisp stepped outlines and bold intentional 4-6 px pixel clusters at output, restrained texture, no high-frequency glitter or noise. Shallow three-quarter front view, upper-left lighting, warm ochre wood/bronze, desaturated blue-grey stone, teal details. Natural wear, coherent perspective, purposeful highlights and substantial shaded volumes, readable small silhouettes. Match existing detailed wooden signposts and RPG sprite characters without making props overly realistic. No soft painting, no airbrush, no 3D plastic, no glow blobs, no unrelated extra objects, no cartoon sticker border.

Transparent background everywhere, no text or characters, no frames, no labels or grid lines. Row1 LEFT: an old iron mining cart tipped on its side, faceted dark ore lumps spilled beside it, visible rail wheels, a small ivory record ledger tied to the side; Row1 RIGHT: a tall carved stone and bronze winter beacon brazier on a square weathered footing, a small restrained amber flame at its top, a little snow on edges, rough wooden support and iron collars. Row3 LEFT: a coiled braided rope hanging around a short weathered wooden anchoring stake with a metal tie ring and a rocky foot; Row3 RIGHT: a single elegant curved teal-blue feather leaning among a few small leaves and stones, pale shaft, finely arranged pixel barbs. assets.edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached sprite atlas of eight fantasy props. Preserve all eight prop identities, colors, design details, pixel art style and transparent background. Change ONLY the scale and placement of the eight props to make a clean production atlas. Canvas aspect is 1:2. Divide it into exactly TWO columns and FOUR equal rows. Fit every prop completely INSIDE its own cell, including the broken shaft of the salt cart and all ore fragments. Shrink objects uniformly to fit within the central 70% of their cell width and central 75% of cell height, leaving generous transparent margins on ALL sides. Each prop centered horizontally, base aligned at 85% of its own cell height. There must be a clearly empty transparent gutter down the central column boundary and at each horizontal row boundary; absolutely no prop, shadow, fragment or glint may cross cell boundaries. Keep order unchanged: mine cart, brazier; lichen, ice monument; rope stake, feather; salt cart, maritime crates. No new objects, no labels, no grid lines or frames. Remove stray isolated background pixels. Do not change any object into simple geometric shapes. Genuine transparent RGBA background.
